chunks: As for what al-Ḥasan ibn Muḥammad ibn Simāʿah narrated from ʿAlī ibn al-Nuʿmān and Ibn Ribāṭ, from Saʿīd al-Aʿraj, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about the time of ẓuhr: is it when the sun declines? He said, “After the decline by a foot-length or something near that, except during travel or on Friday, for its time then is when it declines.”

key_terms.بِقَدَمٍ: by the measure of a foot-length, indicating a short delay
key_terms.زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ: the sun declined from the meridian
key_terms.وَقْتِ الظُّهْرِ: the prescribed time of the noon prayer

ai.seo_question: When does the time of ẓuhr begin according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal timing of salat al-ẓuhr in ordinary circumstances as being slightly after the sun’s decline. It also gives exceptions for travel and the day of الجمعة, when the time begins immediately at the sun’s decline.
